Q1.rationale: Section 3 bars disclosure of Confidential Information to any third party without prior written approval, and the only carve-out in section 4 covers auditors and service providers, so reports to government agencies or regulators are stopped with no whistleblower exception; V1's governing-law insertion does not change this.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: V2 only replaces the governing-law clause with the Nova Scotia and Canada law text, so the section 3 blanket non-disclosure restriction with its only carve-out for auditors and service providers still stops reports to regulators with no exception.
Q2.label: Entailment

Q3.rationale: V3 adds a 36-month employee non-solicitation covenant and does not touch the section 3 non-disclosure restriction, whose only carve-out covers auditors and service providers, so reports to regulators remain barred with no exception.
Q3.label: Entailment
